description.en: Thoroughly reproduced with new RG-compliant modeling! !

description.ja: ＳＥＶＥＮ ＳＷＯＲＤ　セブンソード　－－－－－－
description.en: SEVEN SWORD Seven Sword －－－－－－

description.ja: ●　ＧＮ ＢＵＳＴＥＲ ＳＷＯＲＤII　[ＧＮバスターソードII]
description.en: ● GN BUSTER SWORDII [GN Buster Sword II]

description.ja: 刀身スライド機構、グリップスライド機構を搭載し、ＧＮシールドモードとＧＮソードモードの両形態に変形。
description.en: Equipped with a blade slide mechanism and a grip slide mechanism, it can be transformed into both GNSeal mode and GN Sword mode.

description.ja: ＧＮドライヴ部と腕部に装備が可能。
description.en: Can be equipped on the GN drive part and arm part.

description.ja: 最大時全長　約１６３ｍｍ。
description.en: Total length at maximum: approximately 163mm.

description.ja: 大型のＧＮバスターソードIIを安定してディスプレイできるポーズ保持用スタンドが付属。
description.en: A pose-holding stand is included that allows you to stably display the large GN Buster Sword II.

description.ja: ●　ＧＮ ＳＷＯＲＤ II ＬＯＮＧ　[ＧＮソードIIロング]
description.en: ● GN SWORD II LONG [GN Sword II Long]

description.ja: 携行時は、右腰にマウント。ライフル形態でグリップが展開。
description.en: When carrying it, mount it on your right hip. The grip expands in rifle form.

description.ja: ●　ＧＮ ＳＷＯＲＤ II ＳＨＯＲＴ　[ＧＮソードIIショート]
description.en: ● GN SWORD II SHORT [GN SWORD II SHORT]

description.ja: 携行時、左腰にマウントされるショートは、先端の射出形態をリード線で再現。
description.en: When carried, the short that is mounted on the left hip reproduces the injection form of the tip with a lead wire.

description.ja: ●　ＧＮ ＫＡＴＡＲ　[ＧＮカタール]
description.en: ● GN KATAR [GN Qatar]

description.ja: ＧＮ粒子を纏った刃をクリアパーツで再現。左右の脚部に携行できる他、グリップはスライド展開し、手持ちでの装備が可能。
description.en: The blade wrapped in GN particles is reproduced with clear parts. In addition to being able to be carried on the left and right legs, the grip can be slid out and carried in hand.

description.ja: ２本のＧＮカタールを装着する左右膝アーマーも再現。
description.en: The left and right knee armor equipped with two GN Qatars is also reproduced.

description.ja: ●　ＧＮ ＢＥＡＭ ＳＡＢＥＲ　[ＧＮビームサーベル]
description.en: ● GN BEAM SABER [GN Beam Saber]

description.ja: 腰部に２本携行。ビーム部分はクリアパーツで再現。
description.en: Carry two on your waist. The beam part is reproduced with clear parts.

description.ja: ★　リアリスティックデカールが新規デザインで付属！
description.en: ★ Newly designed realistic decals included!
